note: one frame per harness step, so these are the cost of drawing a frame, not a measured refresh rate
build_is_the_app: build_ms is the framework laying out and painting: the app's own work, and comparable between runs
raster_is_the_machine: raster_ms is CanvasKit turning that into pixels. This capture has no GPU — headless WebKit in a container falls back to a software rasteriser — so raster_ms says what this machine costs, not what a phone would. over_16ms counts build plus raster and is therefore about the machine as much as the app.
